Dear Mr. Reidler: 

This responds to your letter of November 19, 2010, addressed to Mr. Thomas C. Freyman of Abbott Laboratories, providing comments with respect to the disclosures made by Abbott in the referenced filings. This confirms our conversation in which I advised you, on behalf of our client, that Abbott will provide a response to the Commission on or before December 10, 2010. 

Very truly yours, 

Arthur H. Kohn
